changeSet.sql:
-- Link Admin Profile to Admin User INSERT INTO employee_profile (user_id, employee_id, first_name, last_name, nic_number) SELECT (SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE mobile_number = '0771234567'), 'SLR-ADM-001', 'Admin', 'User', '199001011234';
-- Link Clerk Profile to Clerk User INSERT INTO employee_profile (user_id, employee_id, first_name, last_name, nic_number) SELECT (SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE mobile_number = '0712345678'), 'SLR-CLK-002', 'Clerk', 'User', '199502022345';

-- Assign ROLE_ADMIN to the admin user INSERT INTO user_roles (user_id, role_id) SELECT (SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE mobile_number = '0771234567'), (SELECT id FROM role WHERE name = 'ROLE_ADMIN');
-- Assign ROLE_STATION_CLERK to the clerk user INSERT INTO user_roles (user_id, role_id) SELECT (SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE mobile_number = '0712345678'), (SELECT id FROM role WHERE name = 'ROLE_STATION_CLERK');
